posts.summary: The fastest way from your code to Claude is one POST and one stream, and this is it in bash and curl, no jq. It launches a series: one language a week, one file each, measured for what it adds on top of the API.
posts.title: The Hot Path to Claude Is a Shell Script

posts.summary: The second client on the hot path: net/http, encoding/json and a bufio scanner for Server-Sent Events, in a static binary from a scratch image. What the standard library gives you, and the one thing it does not.
posts.title: A Claude Client in One Go File
